findings.title: Diff still over the ~200-line budget
findings.detail: About 327 inserted and 51 deleted non-test lines (~378 changed). Pass 1's suggested classify() trim was applied; the remainder is the WarnRateLimiter, the once-per-request claim flag, RoutingDiagnostics threading, and the SmartRoutingDecisionLog builder, all required by the task.
findings.action: Accept as is, or drop ClassifierMode::as_str (14 lines) if an existing label helper can be reused.

findings.title: Wiki wording on streaming timing, failure mapping, and the second WARN
findings.detail: 'Each completed request' and 'Requests that fail on every provider log no line' only hold for the buffered path; a streaming pass-through logs when the upstream stream is established and stays logged if the relay later fails. 'backend (HTTP/auth/transport)' is inaccurate: System One transport/unexpected-status errors map to unavailable and 422 maps to invalid_output. 'A System One HTTP failure logs a second rate-limited WARN' does not cover gateway-side timeouts, which return before the call-failure arm and log only the router WARN.
findings.action: Reword those three phrases in wiki/Routing-and-Failover.md.

findings.title: No end-to-end dedupe test through a streaming re-plan
findings.detail: claim_smart_routing_log is unit-tested and the pass-through test asserts the claim was consumed, but no test drives pass-through -> re-plan -> 429 -> buffered and checks that the second exit skips the line.
findings.action: Add one if a mock-provider harness for that path is cheap; otherwise acceptable given no tracing-test helper exists.
